sites.name: The pharmacy
sites.blurb: Boarded up the first week. The stock room might still be full.

sites.name: The hardware store
sites.blurb: Shutter dented, ladder left out. Sheet steel, nails, and shells under the counter.

sites.name: Neighbourhood houses
sites.blurb: Doors shut, curtains drawn. Somebody has to go through the cupboards.

sites.name: The scrapyard
sites.blurb: A wrecker's yard: crushed cars, sheet metal, a crane that still has its hook. Nothing here is small.
